title: ClusterMapArtifact
description: Versioned output of the embeddings + K-means clustering pipeline (pipeline-python). Written to artifacts/cluster-map.json. Cross-field invariants this schema cannot express on its own (centroid length must equal embedding.dimensions; clusters.length must equal kmeans.k; cluster ids must be contiguous 0..k-1 in ascending array order) are enforced by pipeline-python's artifact.py at write time, and must be re-checked by any consumer before trusting the file.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for this specific artifact build, e.g. 'clustermap-2026-08-05-k24-s42'.

model_id.description: The exact embedding model used, e.g. 'jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code'. Any consumer embedding a new query for comparison against these centroids MUST use this same model.

normalisation.description: The only normalisation this pipeline/runtime pair implements. A different value means the artifact targets a different runtime.

centroid_dtype.description: Mandatory and hard-checked. float32 centroids would disagree with a float64 runtime near cluster boundaries.

corpus_size.description: Total number of prompts actually embedded and clustered, after dedup.

corpus_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted, normalized corpus content. Lets a re-run on unchanged input be verified byte-for-byte reproducible.

sources.description: Provenance of every dataset that contributed to the corpus. A source's license MAY be 'unverified' if it could not be confirmed at build time — this must never be silently omitted or asserted incorrectly.

size.description: Number of corpus points assigned to this cluster.

label.description: Optional human-readable gloss of what this cluster represents. Not used by any routing logic.

centroid.description: Raw K-means centroid of L2-normalised vectors — NOT itself unit-norm. Must never be re-normalised by a consumer. Length must equal embedding.dimensions (checked at write time, not by this schema).
